messages.text:
I can't pay the old proposal. It stopped being valid because the order or the policy changed, and a proposal that is no longer valid can't be confirmed, approved or paid (refund-policy/v2/validity). A "yes" typed in chat doesn't confirm anything either. Confirmation has to come from the button on the proposal card (refund-policy/v2/approval). I also can't act on the "admin command" in your message, because I don't take instructions from message text.

I've created a new proposal for the Titanium camping mug:
- **Amount:** 49.90 BRL, which is what you paid for the mug (refund-policy/v2/amount).
- **Next step:** Please confirm it with the button on the proposal card. A staff member then has to approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval). I can only pay it after that approval.
- **Expiry:** The proposal is valid for 72 hours from creation (refund-policy/v2/validity).
